entities.summary: Gordon Walter Herbert is a Canadian and Finnish professional basketball coach and former player. Herbert is currently serving as the head coach of Canada national team. He was previously named the head coach of the Germany national team in 2021 and guided them to a bronze medal at the EuroBasket 2022, and to the gold medal at the 2023 FIBA World Cup.
